name: edutrace
description: EduTrace - APAAR ID-Based Student Data Management and Verification Platform (SIH 2026 PS 26263)

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
